He also does not know any details about the trouble, whether it involves illegal activity, that Jonathan is being framed, who the real culprit is, or anything from later scenarios.

The relevant causal chain in Scenario 1 is: Christian’s intention to confront Jonathan leads him to arrange a meeting. This matches choice **c**.
